Key Focus Areas & Design Execution

1. Product Iconography & Visual Systems

  • Challenge: Financial tools often suffer from high cognitive load due to jargon and complex datasets.
  • Design Strategy: Developed a cohesive iconography system designed to establish visual hierarchy and streamline feature navigation across the app.
  • UX Approach: Prioritised clarity and instant recognisability. Conducted targeted usability testing to validate icon comprehension before rollout, resulting in quicker navigation and reduced user friction.

2. Credit Report Redesign

  • Challenge: Traditional credit reports are dense, intimidating, and difficult for average consumers to interpret.
  • Design Strategy: Modernised the report layout into digestible, visual modules incorporating intuitive charts and graphs.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Worked directly with Product Managers and Legal Compliance teams to ensure data transparency met regulatory requirements while dramatically improving readability and engagement.

3. Family & Friends Sharing

  • Challenge: Enable users to securely share credit insights with trusted contacts without exposing sensitive personal identifiers.
  • UX Approach: Designed an intuitive connection-management flow grounded in user privacy and data security.
  • Impact: Created friction-free permission controls that made onboard adoption effortless while adhering to strict fintech security standards.

4. Personalised Financial Marketplace

  • Challenge: Balance revenue goals with user trust by introducing targeted financial product recommendations.
  • Design Strategy: Leveraged user profile data to build a tailored marketplace experience presenting relevant credit cards, loans, and financial offers.
  • Business Impact: Successfully aligned user needs with business conversion targets by framing recommendations around personalised value rather than aggressive sales tactics.

5. Finance Monitor & Design System Components

  • Challenge: Provide proactive financial tracking that prompts user action rather than passive observation.
  • UX Approach: Created a comprehensive monitoring hub featuring real-time alerts, dynamic data visualisations, and actionable financial tips.
  • Design Execution: Constructed modular, reusable UI components to enable seamless engineering handover and maintain design consistency across screens.

Key Outcomes & Business Impact

Metric / Objective Impact Achieved
User Engagement Simplified user journeys and restructured navigation, resulting in higher task completion rates and increased daily active usage within the app.
Conversion & CRO Optimised key calls-to-action (CTAs) and recommendation flows, measurably improving in-app conversion rates across the marketplace.
User Retention Implemented user-centric design patterns and alerts that boosted app stickiness and user retention over time.
Scalability Delivered standardised component libraries that accelerated design-to-development timelines for future feature releases.

myEquifax is a comprehensive financial health platform that gives consumers direct access to their credit reports, monitoring tools, and personalised financial products.

As the Product UX Designer, I was responsible for redesigning key product areas—ranging from foundational visual design systems to complex user flows—aligning consumer usability with strict financial compliance and strategic business growth.
